question: The ancient city of Hampi was the capital of the ______ empire.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Vijayanagar.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hampi was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 14th century.**
 
• Hampi is an ancient village in the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• Hampi's name is derived from that of the local mother goddess,** Pampadevi.**
